name: Standard Push-Up
description: A classic bodyweight exercise targeting the chest, shoulders, and triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with hands shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body until your chest nearly touches the floor.
Keep your core tight and body in a straight line.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

name: Wide Push-Up
description: A push-up variation with hands placed wider than shoulder-width to emphasize the chest.
instructions: Place your hands wider than shoulder-width apart in a plank position.
Lower your chest toward the floor while keeping elbows flared slightly.
Maintain a straight body line from head to heels.
Press back up to the starting position.

name: Diamond Push-Up
description: A push-up variation with hands close together to target the triceps more intensely.
instructions: Place your hands close together beneath your chest, forming a diamond shape with your thumbs and index fingers.
Lower your body until your chest touches your hands.
Keep elbows close to your body throughout the movement.
Push back up to the starting position.

name: Decline Push-Up
description: Feet-elevated push-up that increases the load on the upper chest and shoulders.
instructions: Place your feet on an elevated surface such as a step or chair.
Position your hands shoulder-width apart on the floor.
Lower your chest toward the floor while maintaining a straight body.
Push back up to the starting position.

name: Incline Push-Up
description: Hands-elevated push-up that reduces difficulty and targets the lower chest.
instructions: Place your hands on an elevated surface like a bench or step.
Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the elevated surface.
Push back up to the starting position.

name: Pike Push-Up
description: An inverted push-up position that heavily targets the shoulders, mimicking an overhead press.
instructions: Start in a downward dog position with hips high and hands shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Keep your hips elevated throughout the movement.
Press back up to the starting position.

name: Archer Push-Up
description: An advanced unilateral push-up where one arm does most of the work while the other assists.
instructions: Start in a wide push-up position with arms extended.
Shift your weight to one arm and lower toward that side.
The assisting arm stays relatively straight as a guide.
Push back to center and repeat on the other side.

name: Clap Push-Up
description: An explosive plyometric push-up that builds chest and triceps power.
instructions: Start in a standard push-up position.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands leave the ground.
Clap your hands together and land softly back in push-up position.

name: Spiderman Push-Up
description: A push-up variation where you bring your knee to your elbow to engage the obliques.
instructions: Start in a standard push-up position.
As you lower your body, bring your right knee toward your right elbow.
Push back up while returning the leg to the starting position.
Alternate sides with each rep.

name: Hindu Push-Up
description: A flowing push-up that moves through downward dog to cobra, working the entire upper body.
instructions: Start in a downward dog position with hips high.
Swoop your chest down and forward, skimming the floor.
Press your chest up into a cobra position with hips low.
Push your hips back up to downward dog and repeat.

name: Bodyweight Squat
description: A foundational lower-body exercise that targets the quads, glutes, and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Keep your chest up and weight on your heels.
Lower until thighs are parallel to the floor, then stand back up.

name: Jump Squat
description: An explosive squat variation that builds lower-body power and cardiovascular endurance.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat position.
Explode upward, jumping as high as you can.
Land softly with bent knees and immediately lower into the next rep.

name: Sumo Squat
description: A wide-stance squat that emphasizes the inner thighs and glutes.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width and toes pointed outward at 45 degrees.
Lower your hips straight down by bending your knees.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your heels to return to standing.

name: Pistol Squat
description: An advanced single-leg squat requiring significant strength and balance.
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other leg extended straight in front of you.
Slowly lower your body on the standing leg, keeping the extended leg off the floor.
Descend until your hamstring touches your calf.
Drive through the heel to stand back up.

name: Wall Sit
description: An isometric hold against a wall that builds quad endurance and mental toughness.
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and feet shoulder-width apart.
Slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat against the wall and knees at 90 degrees.
Hold the position for the prescribed time.

name: Forward Lunge
description: A fundamental unilateral leg exercise that builds quad and glute strength.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step forward with one leg and lower your hips until both knees are at 90 degrees.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Push off the front foot to return to the starting position.
Alternate legs with each rep.

name: Reverse Lunge
description: A knee-friendly lunge variation where you step backward instead of forward.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step backward with one leg and lower until both knees form 90-degree angles.
Keep your front knee stable and torso upright.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.

name: Walking Lunge
description: A dynamic lunge that challenges balance and coordination as you travel forward.
instructions: Stand tall and take a large step forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees are at 90 degrees.
Push off the back foot and step it forward into the next lunge.
Continue alternating legs as you walk forward.

name: Lateral Lunge
description: A side-stepping lunge that targets the inner thighs and improves lateral mobility.
instructions: Stand with feet together and hands at your chest.
Take a large step to the right, bending your right knee while keeping the left leg straight.
Push your hips back and keep your chest up.
Push off the right foot to return to center and repeat on the other side.

name: Jump Lunge
description: An explosive alternating lunge that develops lower-body power and agility.
instructions: Start in a lunge position with one foot forward.
Jump explosively, switching legs in mid-air.
Land softly in a lunge with the opposite leg forward.
Immediately jump again to continue alternating.

name: Curtsy Lunge
description: A lunge where you cross your leg behind the other to emphasize the glute medius.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Step your right leg diagonally behind your left leg as if curtsying.
Lower your hips until your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.

name: Forearm Plank
description: An isometric core exercise that strengthens the entire abdominal region and stabilizers.
instructions: Place your forearms on the ground with elbows directly beneath your shoulders.
Extend your legs back and balance on your toes.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and hold for the prescribed time.

name: High Plank
description: A plank performed on your hands that also engages the shoulders and arms.
instructions: Start in the top of a push-up position with hands under shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and avoid letting your hips sag or pike.
Hold for the prescribed time.

name: Side Plank
description: A lateral core exercise that targets the obliques and improves lateral stability.
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm on the ground and elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet on top of each other.
Lift your hips off the ground to form a straight line.
Hold for the prescribed time, then switch sides.

name: Plank Shoulder Tap
description: A dynamic plank variation that challenges anti-rotation stability.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with feet slightly wider than hip-width.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Return the hand to the floor and repeat on the other side.
Minimize hip rotation throughout the movement.

name: Mountain Climber
description: A dynamic core and cardio exercise that simulates a running motion in plank position.
instructions: Start in a high plank position.
Drive one knee toward your chest quickly.
Return it to the starting position and immediately drive the other knee forward.
Continue alternating at a rapid pace.

name: Burpee
description: A full-body conditioning exercise combining a squat, push-up, and jump.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into a squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a plank and perform a push-up.
Jump your feet forward to your hands and explode upward into a jump.
Land softly and immediately begin the next rep.

name: Half Burpee
description: A modified burpee without the push-up, making it more accessible while still providing full-body conditioning.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into a squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a plank position.
Jump your feet forward to your hands and stand up.

name: Bicycle Crunch
description: A rotational core exercise that targets both the rectus abdominis and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with hands behind your head and legs elevated.
Bring your right elbow toward your left knee while extending the right leg.
Alternate sides in a pedaling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor throughout.

name: Crunch
description: A basic abdominal exercise that isolates the upper portion of the rectus abdominis.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by contracting your abs.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

name: Russian Twist
description: A seated rotational core exercise that targets the obliques and improves torso rotation.
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet slightly elevated.
Lean back slightly to engage your core.
Rotate your torso to the right, then to the left.
Keep your core braced and move in a controlled manner.

name: Lying Leg Raise
description: A core exercise that targets the lower abdominals by raising the legs while lying flat.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands at your sides or under your hips.
Keeping legs straight, raise them until they are perpendicular to the floor.
Slowly lower your legs back down without touching the floor.
Keep your lower back pressed into the ground throughout.

name: Flutter Kick
description: A rapid alternating leg movement that targets the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with hands under your hips for support.
Lift both legs slightly off the ground.
Alternate kicking each leg up and down in a small, rapid motion.
Keep your core tight and lower back pressed to the floor.

name: Dead Bug
description: An anti-extension core exercise that builds stability while moving the limbs.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms extended toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Slowly extend your right arm overhead and your left leg straight out.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.

name: V-Up
description: An advanced core exercise where you simultaneously raise your arms and legs to form a V shape.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with arms extended overhead.
Simultaneously lift your legs and torso, reaching your hands toward your toes.
Your body should form a V shape at the top.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

name: Superman
description: A prone exercise that strengthens the lower back and posterior chain.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead.
Simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and legs off the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and lower back at the top.
Hold briefly, then lower back down.

name: Glute Bridge
description: A hip extension exercise that isolates and activates the glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips.
Form a straight line from shoulders to knees at the top.
Lower your hips back down with control.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
description: A unilateral glute bridge that increases the load on each glute individually.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and one foot on the floor.
Extend the other leg straight up or hold it in the air.
Drive through the grounded heel to lift your hips.
Lower with control and repeat on both sides.

name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
description: A simple exercise to strengthen the calf muscles using just your body weight.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart near a wall for balance if needed.
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
Squeeze your calves at the top.
Slowly lower back down and repeat.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
description: A calf raise performed on one leg for increased resistance and balance challenge.
instructions: Stand on one foot near a wall for balance support.
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
Squeeze the calf at the top and hold briefly.
Lower back down slowly and complete all reps before switching legs.

name: Donkey Kick
description: A glute isolation exercise performed on all fours by kicking one leg toward the ceiling.
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keeping your knee bent at 90 degrees, lift one leg toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glute at the top of the movement.
Lower with control and repeat on both sides.

name: Fire Hydrant
description: A hip abduction exercise that targets the glute medius and improves hip stability.
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keeping your knee bent, lift one leg out to the side.
Raise it until your thigh is parallel to the floor.
Lower back down with control and repeat on both sides.

name: Step-Up
description: A unilateral lower-body exercise that mimics stair climbing to build leg strength.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy elevated surface like a step or chair.
Place one foot fully on the surface.
Drive through the elevated foot to step up, extending your hip and knee.
Step back down with control and repeat on both sides.

name: Box Jump
description: An explosive plyometric exercise that builds lower-body power and coordination.
instructions: Stand in front of a sturdy box or elevated surface.
Swing your arms and jump onto the box, landing with both feet.
Stand fully upright on the box.
Step down carefully and repeat.

name: Tuck Jump
description: A high-intensity plyometric exercise where you bring your knees to your chest mid-jump.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Jump explosively upward.
Pull your knees toward your chest at the peak of the jump.
Land softly with bent knees and immediately repeat.

name: High Knees
description: A cardio exercise where you jog in place, driving your knees up to hip height.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee up to hip height while pumping the opposite arm.
Quickly switch legs in a running motion.
Maintain an upright posture and fast pace.

name: Butt Kick
description: A cardio exercise where you jog in place, kicking your heels toward your glutes.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Jog in place, kicking your heels up toward your glutes.
Pump your arms naturally as you move.
Maintain an upright posture and brisk pace.

name: Jumping Jack
description: A classic cardio exercise that elevates heart rate and warms up the whole body.
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump and spread your feet wide while raising your arms overhead.
Jump again to return to the starting position.
Continue at a steady pace.

name: Skater Jump
description: A lateral plyometric exercise that improves agility and single-leg power.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Jump laterally to the opposite side, landing on the other leg.
Swing your arms across your body for momentum.
Immediately jump back to the starting side and repeat.

name: Bear Crawl
description: A full-body locomotion exercise that challenges coordination and core stability.
instructions: Start on all fours with knees hovering just above the ground.
Move forward by stepping the opposite hand and foot simultaneously.
Keep your hips low and core engaged.
Continue crawling for the prescribed distance or time.

name: Inchworm
description: A dynamic full-body exercise that stretches the hamstrings and strengthens the core.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and walk your hands out to a plank position.
Hold briefly, then walk your hands back toward your feet.
Stand back up and repeat.

name: Bodyweight Dip
description: A triceps-focused exercise performed using a chair or elevated surface behind you.
instructions: Place your hands on the edge of a chair behind you with fingers forward.
Extend your legs out in front with heels on the floor.
Lower your body by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Press back up to straighten your arms.

name: Plank Up-Down
description: A dynamic plank that alternates between forearm and high plank to build arm and core strength.
instructions: Start in a forearm plank position.
Press up to a high plank one arm at a time.
Lower back to the forearm plank one arm at a time.
Alternate which arm leads each rep.

name: Hollow Body Hold
description: A gymnastics-inspired isometric core exercise that builds total abdominal tension.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms, shoulders, and legs off the floor simultaneously.
Press your lower back firmly into the ground.
Hold the position for the prescribed time.

name: Broad Jump
description: A horizontal plyometric jump that develops explosive lower-body power.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees to load.
Swing arms forward and jump as far as you can horizontally.
Land softly with bent knees.

name: Crab Walk
description: A reverse crawling movement that strengthens the triceps, shoulders, and core.
instructions: Sit on the floor and place hands behind you with fingers pointing forward.
Lift your hips off the ground.
Walk forward or backward using your hands and feet.
Keep your hips elevated throughout.

name: Squat Pulse
description: A squat variation where you pulse at the bottom of the movement for constant tension.
instructions: Lower into a squat position with thighs parallel to the floor.
Pulse up and down a few inches without fully standing.
Keep your weight in your heels and chest up.
Continue pulsing for the prescribed number of reps.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
description: A chest exercise performed on a bench pressing dumbbells upward for balanced strength development.
instructions: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back to chest level with control.
Keep your feet flat on the floor and back slightly arched.

name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
description: An incline pressing movement that targets the upper chest and front deltoids.
instructions: Set a bench to a 30-45 degree incline and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Press the dumbbells up over your upper chest.
Lower them back down with control to shoulder level.
Keep your feet flat and core braced.

name: Dumbbell Fly
description: An isolation exercise that stretches and contracts the chest muscles through a wide arc.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms extended above your chest.
With a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbells out to the sides.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back together.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: An overhead pressing movement that builds shoulder size and strength.
instructions: Sit or stand with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder level with control.
Keep your core tight and avoid arching your back.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description: An isolation exercise that targets the side deltoids for broader shoulders.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows throughout.
Lower the dumbbells back down slowly.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
description: An isolation exercise targeting the front deltoids by raising dumbbells to the front.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your thighs.
Raise one or both dumbbells straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Keep your arms slightly bent and core braced.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
description: A bent-over fly that isolates the rear deltoids and upper back.
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a dumbbell in each hand hanging below your chest.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise the dumbbells out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
description: A classic arm exercise that isolates the biceps through elbow flexion.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides, palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders by bending your elbows.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
description: A curl variation with a neutral grip that targets both the biceps and forearms.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Curl the dumbbells up while maintaining the neutral grip.
Squeeze at the top and keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension
description: An overhead extension that targets all three heads of the triceps.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead, arms fully extended.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Keep your upper arms close to your head and elbows pointing forward.
Extend your arms back to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
description: A bent-over isolation exercise that targets the triceps by extending the arm behind you.
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a dumbbell in one hand, upper arm parallel to your torso.
Extend your forearm back until your arm is fully straight.
Squeeze the tricep at the top.
Return to the starting position and repeat on both sides.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
description: A compound back exercise that builds thickness in the lats and mid-back.
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a dumbbell in each hand, back flat.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
description: A unilateral row performed with one arm for balanced back development.
instructions: Place one hand and knee on a bench for support, holding a dumbbell in the other hand.
Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip, keeping your elbow close.
Squeeze your back at the top of the movement.
Lower with control and complete all reps before switching sides.

name: Dumbbell Renegade Row
description: A plank-based rowing exercise that challenges core stability while building back strength.
instructions: Get into a high plank position with hands on two dumbbells.
Row one dumbbell up to your hip while stabilizing with the other arm.
Lower the dumbbell and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips level and core tight throughout.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
description: A front-loaded squat that promotes an upright torso and targets the quads and glutes.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically at your chest with both hands cupping one end.
Squat down by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Keep your chest up and elbows between your knees.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

name: Dumbbell Lunge
description: A weighted lunge that increases resistance for greater leg and glute development.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward into a lunge, lowering until both knees are at 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and front knee over your ankle.
Push back to standing and alternate legs.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
description: A hip hinge exercise that targets the hamstrings and glutes with a controlled eccentric.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Hinge at your hips and push them back, lowering the dumbbells along your legs.
Keep a slight bend in your knees and your back flat.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then drive your hips forward to stand.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
description: A weighted calf raise using dumbbells for added resistance.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
Squeeze your calves at the top.
Lower slowly back down and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
description: An isolation exercise that targets the upper trapezius muscles.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold briefly at the top and squeeze your traps.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
description: An isolation exercise for the forearm flexors performed with palms facing up.
instructions: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs with a dumbbell in each hand, palms up.
Let the dumbbells roll to your fingertips.
Curl the dumbbells up by flexing your wrists.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Concentration Curl
description: A seated curl that isolates the bicep by bracing the elbow against the inner thigh.
instructions: Sit on a bench with legs spread and one dumbbell in hand.
Brace the back of your upper arm against your inner thigh.
Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly and complete all reps before switching arms.

name: Dumbbell Arnold Press
description: A rotational shoulder press that works all three deltoid heads through a full range of motion.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing you.
As you press overhead, rotate your palms to face forward.
Fully extend your arms at the top.
Reverse the rotation as you lower back down.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
description: A chest and lat exercise performed lying on a bench, moving a dumbbell in an arc overhead.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a single dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head, keeping a slight bend in the elbows.
Stretch until you feel your lats and chest engage.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
description: A full-body compound exercise combining a front squat with an overhead press.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing each other.
Squat down until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive up explosively and press the dumbbells overhead in one fluid motion.
Lower the dumbbells back to your shoulders as you descend into the next squat.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
description: A weighted step-up that increases the challenge for quads and glutes.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Place one foot on an elevated surface.
Drive through the elevated foot to step up fully.
Step back down with control and repeat on both sides.

name: Barbell Back Squat
description: The king of compound exercises, targeting the quads, glutes, and entire posterior chain.
instructions: Position a barbell on your upper back and unrack it.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower until thighs are parallel, then drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up and core braced throughout.

name: Barbell Front Squat
description: A front-loaded squat that emphasizes the quads and demands more core stability.
instructions: Rest the barbell across the front of your shoulders in a clean grip or crossed-arm position.
Keep your elbows high and chest up.
Squat down while maintaining an upright torso.
Drive through your heels to return to standing.

name: Barbell Deadlift
description: A fundamental compound lift that works the entire posterior chain from the floor up.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell over mid-foot.
Hinge at hips and bend knees to grip the bar just outside your legs.
Drive through your heels, extending hips and knees simultaneously.
Stand tall with the bar at hip height, then lower it back to the floor.
Keep your back flat and core braced throughout.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
description: A hip hinge with a barbell that emphasizes the hamstrings and glutes with a controlled negative.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell at hip height with an overhand grip.
Push your hips back and lower the bar along your legs.
Keep a slight bend in your knees and your back flat.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then drive hips forward.

name: Barbell Bench Press
description: A fundamental pressing exercise that builds chest, shoulder, and tricep strength.
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your mid-chest.
Press the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Keep your feet flat, back slightly arched, and shoulder blades retracted.

name: Barbell Incline Bench Press
description: An incline pressing variation that emphasizes the upper chest and front deltoids.
instructions: Set a bench to a 30-45 degree incline.
Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width and unrack.
Lower the bar to your upper chest.
Press the bar back up to full arm extension.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
description: A standing overhead press that builds strong shoulders and tests total-body stability.
instructions: Stand with the barbell at shoulder height, gripping slightly wider than shoulders.
Brace your core and press the bar straight overhead.
Lock out your arms at the top.
Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
description: A heavy compound row that builds back thickness and overall pulling strength.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hinge forward holding a barbell with an overhand grip.
Pull the barbell toward your lower chest or upper abdomen.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the bar with control and repeat.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
description: A glute-focused exercise using a barbell across the hips for maximum glute activation.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your upper back against a bench and a barbell across your hips.
Plant your feet flat on the floor at hip-width.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and lower with control.

name: Barbell Curl
description: A bilateral bicep exercise that allows for heavier loads than dumbbells.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a barbell with an underhand grip.
Curl the barbell up toward your shoulders.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and avoid swinging.
Lower the barbell back down with control.

name: Barbell Skull Crusher
description: A lying tricep extension that targets all three heads of the triceps.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a barbell with arms extended above your chest.
Lower the barbell toward your forehead by bending your elbows.
Keep your upper arms stationary and perpendicular to the floor.
Extend your arms back to the starting position.

name: Barbell Sumo Deadlift
description: A wide-stance deadlift variation that emphasizes the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with a wide stance and toes pointed outward, barbell over mid-foot.
Grip the bar between your legs with arms straight.
Drive through your heels and extend hips and knees to stand.
Lower the bar back down with control.

name: Barbell Close-Grip Bench Press
description: A bench press with a narrow grip that shifts emphasis to the triceps.
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip the barbell with hands shoulder-width apart or narrower.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your lower chest.
Keep your elbows tucked close to your body.
Press the bar back up to full arm extension.

name: Barbell Upright Row
description: A pulling exercise that targets the shoulders and upper traps.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly narrower than shoulder-width.
Pull the barbell straight up along your body toward your chin.
Lead with your elbows, keeping them higher than your hands.
Lower the bar with control and repeat.

name: Barbell Good Morning
description: A hip hinge exercise with the barbell on your back that strengthens the posterior chain.
instructions: Place a barbell on your upper back as you would for a squat.
With a slight knee bend, hinge forward at the hips.
Lower your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.

name: Barbell Clean and Press
description: A full-body power exercise that combines pulling the bar from the floor to the shoulders and pressing overhead.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell on the floor.
Pull the bar explosively to your shoulders in a clean motion.
Catch the bar at shoulder height with knees slightly bent.
Press the bar overhead to full lockout.
Lower back to shoulders, then to the floor.

name: Barbell Lunge
description: A barbell-loaded lunge that adds significant resistance for lower-body development.
instructions: Place a barbell on your upper back.
Step forward into a lunge, lowering until both knees are at 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and core braced.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.

name: Barbell Calf Raise
description: A weighted calf raise using a barbell on the back for heavy loading.
instructions: Place a barbell on your upper back as in a squat position.
Stand on a slightly elevated surface with your heels hanging off.
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
Lower your heels below the platform and repeat.

name: Barbell Reverse Curl
description: A curl with an overhand grip that targets the brachioradialis and forearm extensors.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand (pronated) grip.
Curl the barbell up toward your shoulders.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: A powerful hip hinge movement that builds posterior chain strength and cardiovascular endurance.
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips and grab the kettlebell with both hands.
Swing the kettlebell back between your legs, then drive your hips forward explosively.
Let the kettlebell swing to chest height with arms straight.
Control the descent and repeat in a fluid motion.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
description: A front-loaded squat holding a kettlebell at the chest for excellent squat form.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at chest level.
Squat down by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Keep your chest up and elbows between your knees.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up
description: A complex full-body exercise where you rise from the floor to standing while holding a kettlebell overhead.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell in one hand with arm extended toward the ceiling.
Roll to your side, prop yourself on your elbow, then your hand.
Sweep your leg under you to a kneeling position.
Stand up while keeping the kettlebell overhead.
Reverse the steps to return to the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Clean
description: A pulling movement that brings the kettlebell from the floor to the rack position at your shoulder.
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge and grip the kettlebell with one hand.
Drive your hips forward and pull the kettlebell to shoulder height.
Rotate your hand and let the kettlebell rest against your forearm in the rack position.

name: Kettlebell Press
description: A single-arm overhead press with a kettlebell that challenges shoulder stability.
instructions: Clean the kettlebell to the rack position at your shoulder.
Press the kettlebell overhead until your arm is fully extended.
Keep your core tight and avoid leaning to the side.
Lower the kettlebell back to the rack position.

name: Kettlebell Snatch
description: An explosive full-body movement that swings the kettlebell from between your legs to overhead in one motion.
instructions: Start with the kettlebell between your legs in a hinge position.
Swing the kettlebell back, then drive your hips forward explosively.
As the kettlebell rises, punch your hand through the handle to catch it overhead.
Lock out your arm at the top and lower back to the start.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
description: A beginner-friendly deadlift using a kettlebell to learn the hip hinge pattern.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart with a kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grab the kettlebell.
Drive through your heels and extend your hips to stand tall.
Lower the kettlebell back to the ground with a flat back.

name: Kettlebell Windmill
description: A lateral bending exercise that improves hip and shoulder mobility while strengthening the core.
instructions: Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm and lock it out.
Turn your feet 45 degrees away from the loaded arm.
Hinge at the hips and reach your free hand toward the floor.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell and return to standing.

name: Kettlebell Halo
description: A shoulder mobility exercise where you circle the kettlebell around your head.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the horns at chest level.
Circle the kettlebell around your head in a smooth motion.
Keep your core tight and elbows close.
Complete reps in one direction, then reverse.

name: Kettlebell Row
description: A single-arm row with a kettlebell that builds back strength and grip.
instructions: Hinge at the hips with one hand on a bench and a kettlebell in the other.
Pull the kettlebell toward your hip, squeezing your back.
Keep your elbow close to your body.
Lower with control and complete all reps before switching.

name: Kettlebell Sumo Squat
description: A wide-stance squat holding a kettlebell between the legs for inner thigh and glute emphasis.
instructions: Stand with a wide stance and toes turned out, holding a kettlebell with both hands.
Lower your hips straight down, keeping the kettlebell between your legs.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.
Drive through your heels to return to standing.

name: Kettlebell Racked Lunge
description: A lunge performed with a kettlebell in the rack position for added core and shoulder challenge.
instructions: Clean a kettlebell to the rack position at one shoulder.
Step forward into a lunge, lowering until both knees are at 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and core engaged against the offset load.
Push back to standing and alternate legs.

name: Kettlebell Farmer's Carry
description: A loaded carry that builds grip strength, core stability, and total-body endurance.
instructions: Pick up a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Stand tall with shoulders back and core braced.
Walk forward with controlled, even steps.
Maintain an upright posture for the prescribed distance or time.

name: Kettlebell Figure Eight
description: A dynamic exercise where you pass the kettlebell between your legs in a figure-eight pattern.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width and hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Pass the kettlebell between your legs to the opposite hand from behind.
Bring it around the outside of your leg and pass it back through.
Continue in a smooth figure-eight motion.

name: Pull-Up
description: A foundational upper-body pulling exercise using an overhand grip on a bar.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, palms facing away.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar.
Squeeze your back and biceps at the top.
Lower yourself with control to a full dead hang.

name: Chin-Up
description: A pull-up variation with an underhand grip that emphasizes the biceps more.
instructions: Hang from a bar with hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing you.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Squeeze your biceps and back at the top.
Lower with control to a full hang.

name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
description: A pull-up with a wider grip that emphasizes the outer lats for a wider back.
instructions: Hang from a bar with hands wider than shoulder-width, palms facing away.
Pull yourself up, leading with your chest toward the bar.
Squeeze your lats at the top.
Lower yourself back to a full hang.

name: Negative Pull-Up
description: A pull-up progression focused on the lowering phase to build pulling strength.
instructions: Use a step or jump to get your chin above the bar.
Slowly lower yourself down over 3-5 seconds.
Control the descent until your arms are fully extended.
Step back up and repeat.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: An advanced core exercise performed hanging from a bar, targeting the lower abs.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms fully extended.
Raise your legs in front of you until they are parallel to the floor or higher.
Keep your legs as straight as possible.
Lower with control and avoid swinging.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
description: A hanging core exercise where you raise bent knees toward your chest.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms extended.
Raise your knees toward your chest by curling your pelvis.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower your legs back down with control.

name: Dead Hang
description: A grip and shoulder endurance exercise where you simply hang from a bar.
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Let your body hang freely with arms fully extended.
Relax your shoulders and engage your grip.
Hold for the prescribed time.

name: Commando Pull-Up
description: A pull-up performed with a neutral grip, alternating which side your head passes the bar.
instructions: Grip the bar with hands close together, one in front of the other, palms facing each other.
Pull up and bring your head to one side of the bar.
Lower back down and pull up to the other side.
Alternate sides each rep.

name: Muscle-Up
description: An advanced calisthenics move that combines a pull-up with a dip to get above the bar.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a false grip (wrists over the bar).
Perform an explosive pull-up, pulling your chest above the bar.
Transition your wrists over the bar and press up into a dip.
Lock out your arms at the top, then lower back to a hang.

name: Bench Dip
description: A triceps exercise using a bench for support, easier than parallel bar dips.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with hands gripping the edge beside your hips.
Slide forward off the bench with legs extended.
Lower your body by bending elbows to about 90 degrees.
Press back up to full arm extension.

name: Bench Step-Up
description: A step-up exercise using a bench for a deeper range of motion.
instructions: Stand facing a bench and place one foot on it.
Drive through the elevated foot to step up completely.
Bring the trailing leg up, then step back down.
Repeat on both sides.

name: Bench Hip Thrust
description: A bodyweight hip thrust with your back elevated on a bench for greater range of motion.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against a bench.
Place your feet flat on the floor at hip-width.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and lower with control.

name: Bench Decline Push-Up
description: A push-up with feet on a bench to increase upper chest and shoulder engagement.
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and hands on the floor in a push-up position.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Push back up to the starting position.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: A single-leg squat with the rear foot elevated on a bench for deep quad and glute work.
instructions: Stand a few feet in front of a bench and place one foot behind you on the bench.
Lower your body by bending your front knee to about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to return to standing.

name: Resistance Band Pull-Apart
description: A shoulder and upper back exercise where you pull a band apart at chest height.
instructions: Hold a resistance band in front of you at shoulder height with arms extended.
Pull the band apart by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Extend until the band touches your chest.
Return slowly to the starting position.

name: Resistance Band Bicep Curl
description: A bicep curl using a resistance band for constant tension throughout the range of motion.
instructions: Stand on the center of a resistance band with feet hip-width apart.
Hold the ends of the band with palms facing forward.
Curl your hands toward your shoulders, keeping elbows at your sides.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Resistance Band Lateral Walk
description: A glute activation exercise where you side-step against band resistance.
instructions: Place a resistance band around your legs just above the knees or ankles.
Get into a quarter squat position.
Step sideways, maintaining tension on the band.
Take several steps in one direction, then reverse.

name: Resistance Band Shoulder Press
description: An overhead press using a resistance band for shoulder development.
instructions: Stand on the center of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band at shoulder height with palms forward.
Press your hands overhead until arms are fully extended.
Lower back to shoulder height with control.

name: Resistance Band Squat
description: A squat with band resistance around the thighs to increase glute activation.
instructions: Place a resistance band just above your knees.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down while pressing your knees outward against the band.
Stand back up while maintaining outward pressure on the band.

name: Resistance Band Chest Press
description: A pressing exercise using a band anchored behind you for chest development.
instructions: Anchor a resistance band behind you at chest height.
Hold the ends and step forward to create tension.
Press your hands forward until arms are extended.
Return to the starting position with control.

name: Resistance Band Seated Row
description: A seated rowing exercise using a resistance band to target the mid-back.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended and loop a band around your feet.
Hold the ends of the band with both hands.
Pull the band toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms back forward with control.

name: Resistance Band Tricep Pushdown
description: A tricep isolation exercise using a band anchored overhead.
instructions: Anchor a resistance band overhead to a pull-up bar or door frame.
Grip the band with both hands at chest height.
Push your hands down by extending your elbows.
Keep upper arms stationary and return with control.

name: Resistance Band Face Pull
description: A band exercise that strengthens the rear deltoids and improves posture.
instructions: Anchor a band at face height and hold each end with an overhand grip.
Step back to create tension with arms extended.
Pull the band toward your face, flaring your elbows out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades and return with control.

name: Resistance Band Leg Curl
description: A hamstring isolation exercise using a resistance band anchored at the ankle.
instructions: Anchor a band low to the ground and loop it around one ankle.
Stand facing the anchor point.
Curl your heel toward your glute against the band resistance.
Lower with control and repeat on both legs.

name: Resistance Band Clamshell
description: A hip external rotation exercise with band resistance to activate the glute medius.
instructions: Lie on your side with a resistance band around both knees.
Keep your feet together and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Open your top knee against the band, keeping feet together.
Lower with control and complete all reps before switching sides.

name: Resistance Band Glute Kickback
description: A glute-focused kickback using band resistance for constant tension.
instructions: Get on all fours and loop a resistance band around one foot and the opposite knee.
Kick the banded leg straight back, extending your hip.
Squeeze your glute at the top of the movement.
Return to the starting position and repeat on both sides.

name: Resistance Band Lateral Raise
description: A shoulder isolation exercise using band resistance for the side deltoids.
instructions: Stand on the center of a resistance band with feet together.
Hold the ends at your sides with arms slightly bent.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Resistance Band Pallof Press
description: An anti-rotation core exercise that builds rotational stability.
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height to your side.
Hold the band with both hands at your chest.
Press the band straight out in front of you.
Resist the rotational pull and bring it back to your chest.

name: Arm Circles
description: A dynamic warm-up exercise that loosens the shoulder joints and increases blood flow.
instructions: Stand with arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height.
Make small circles with your arms, gradually increasing the size.
After 15-20 seconds, reverse the direction.
Keep your core engaged and posture tall.

name: Leg Swings
description: A dynamic warm-up that loosens the hip joints through pendulum-like leg movements.
instructions: Stand near a wall for balance support.
Swing one leg forward and backward in a controlled manner.
Gradually increase the range of motion.
Repeat on the other leg, then perform lateral swings.

name: Hip Circles
description: A dynamic warm-up that mobilizes the hip joints through circular movements.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
Make large circles with your hips in a clockwise direction.
Complete the prescribed reps, then reverse direction.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.

name: Torso Twist
description: A standing rotational warm-up that prepares the spine and core for movement.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms raised to shoulder height.
Rotate your upper body to the right, then to the left.
Keep your hips facing forward and let your arms swing naturally.
Gradually increase the range of motion.

name: Neck Rolls
description: A gentle warm-up that loosens neck tension and improves cervical mobility.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with shoulders relaxed.
Slowly roll your head in a circle, bringing your ear toward your shoulder.
Complete circles in one direction, then reverse.
Move slowly and avoid any sharp movements.

name: Ankle Circles
description: A warm-up exercise that mobilizes the ankle joints before lower-body work.
instructions: Lift one foot off the ground slightly.
Rotate your foot in a circular motion at the ankle.
Complete circles in both directions.
Repeat on the other foot.

name: High Knee March
description: A low-impact warm-up that elevates heart rate and activates the hip flexors.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Lift one knee to hip height while swinging the opposite arm.
Place the foot down and lift the other knee.
Continue at a marching pace.

name: Shoulder Shrugs
description: A warm-up that releases tension in the upper trapezius and neck area.
instructions: Stand with arms at your sides and shoulders relaxed.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Hold briefly at the top.
Release and let them drop back down.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
description: A comprehensive dynamic stretch that opens the hips, thoracic spine, and shoulders.
instructions: Step into a deep lunge with your right foot forward.
Place your left hand on the ground and rotate your right arm toward the ceiling.
Hold briefly, then bring your arm back down.
Step forward and repeat on the other side.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
description: A dynamic spinal warm-up that alternates between flexion and extension.
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Arch your back and drop your belly (cow position).
Round your spine upward and tuck your chin (cat position).
Flow between these positions slowly.

name: Wrist Circles
description: A warm-up that mobilizes the wrist joints before pressing or weight-bearing exercises.
instructions: Extend your arms in front of you.
Make fists and rotate your wrists in circles.
Complete circles in both directions.
Shake your hands out when finished.

name: Lateral Shuffle
description: A dynamic warm-up that prepares the body for lateral movements and activates the glutes.
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance with knees slightly bent.
Shuffle sideways for several steps, staying low.
Reverse direction and shuffle back.
Keep your chest up and feet quick.

name: A-Skip
description: A dynamic warm-up drill that activates the hip flexors and prepares for running.
instructions: Skip forward while driving one knee up to hip height.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Alternate legs with each skip.
Pump your arms in coordination with your legs.

name: Bodyweight Good Morning
description: A warm-up hip hinge that prepares the hamstrings and lower back for heavier work.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands behind your head.
Hinge forward at the hips, pushing them back.
Keep a flat back and slight knee bend.
Return to standing by driving your hips forward.

name: Scapular Push-Up
description: A warm-up that activates the serratus anterior and promotes healthy scapular movement.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with arms straight.
Without bending your elbows, let your shoulder blades squeeze together.
Push your shoulder blades apart by pressing the floor away.
Repeat in a slow, controlled manner.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
description: A static stretch that targets the quadriceps muscles after lower-body work.
instructions: Stand on one leg, using a wall for balance if needed.
Grab the opposite ankle and pull your heel toward your glute.
Keep your knees close together and torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch legs.

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
description: A standing forward fold that stretches the hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and reach toward your toes.
Keep a slight bend in your knees to protect the lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

name: Doorway Chest Stretch
description: A stretch that opens the chest and front deltoids using a doorframe or wall.
instructions: Stand in a doorway and place your forearm against the frame at shoulder height.
Step forward with one foot until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Repeat on the other side.

name: Overhead Tricep Stretch
description: A stretch for the triceps performed by reaching behind the head.
instructions: Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow behind your head.
Use the opposite hand to gently press on the elbow.
Feel the stretch along the back of your arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch arms.

name: Wall Calf Stretch
description: A stretch for the calves performed by pressing against a wall.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot forward and one foot back.
Press your back heel into the floor and lean into the wall.
Keep your back leg straight to stretch the gastrocnemius.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.

name: Pigeon Stretch
description: A deep hip opener that stretches the glutes and hip flexors.
instructions: From a plank, bring one knee forward and place it behind the same-side wrist.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Sink your hips toward the floor and fold forward if comfortable.
Hold for 30-60 seconds and switch sides.

name: Child's Pose
description: A relaxing stretch that gently lengthens the back, lats, and hips.
instructions: Kneel on the floor with toes together and knees apart.
Sit back on your heels and extend your arms forward on the floor.
Lower your forehead toward the ground.
Hold for 30-60 seconds, breathing deeply.

name: Figure Four Stretch
description: A supine hip stretch that targets the deep glute muscles and piriformis.
instructions: Lie on your back and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Reach through and pull the bottom leg toward your chest.
Keep your head and shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
description: A simple stretch that targets the posterior deltoid and upper back.
instructions: Bring one arm across your chest at shoulder height.
Use the opposite hand to gently press the arm closer to your body.
Feel the stretch in the back of your shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch arms.

name: Supine Spinal Twist
description: A lying twist that stretches the lower back and promotes spinal mobility.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms extended to the sides.
Bring one knee across your body toward the floor on the opposite side.
Keep both shoulders on the ground.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.

name: Cobra Stretch
description: A prone back extension stretch that opens the chest and stretches the abdominals.
instructions: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
Press your upper body up while keeping your hips on the floor.
Straighten your arms as much as comfortable.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.

name: Seated Forward Fold
description: A seated stretch that targets the hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended straight in front of you.
Hinge at the hips and reach toward your toes.
Keep your back as straight as possible.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

name: Butterfly Stretch
description: A seated hip stretch that targets the inner thighs and groin.
instructions: Sit on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together.
Let your knees fall open to the sides.
Gently press your knees toward the floor with your hands.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

name: Neck Side Stretch
description: A gentle stretch to release tension in the neck and upper trapezius.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to one side, bringing your ear toward your shoulder.
Gently use your hand to deepen the stretch.
Hold for 15-20 seconds and switch sides.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
description: A lunge-position stretch that targets tight hip flexors from sitting.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a lunge position.
Push your hips forward gently until you feel a stretch in the back hip.
Keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.

name: Downward Dog
description: A yoga pose that stretches the hamstrings, calves, and shoulders while building upper body strength.
instructions: Start on all fours and push your hips up and back.
Straighten your legs and press your heels toward the floor.
Keep your arms straight and spread your fingers wide.
Hold for 30-60 seconds, pedaling your feet if needed.

name: Upward Dog
description: A yoga pose that opens the chest and stretches the hip flexors and abdominals.
instructions: Lie face down and place your hands under your shoulders.
Press up until your arms are straight, lifting your thighs off the floor.
Roll your shoulders back and lift your chest.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.

name: Warrior I Pose
description: A standing yoga pose that stretches the hip flexors and strengthens the legs.
instructions: Step one foot forward into a wide stance.
Bend your front knee to 90 degrees while keeping the back leg straight.
Raise your arms overhead and square your hips forward.
Hold for 30 seconds and switch sides.

name: Warrior II Pose
description: A standing yoga pose that opens the hips and strengthens the legs and core.
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart, turning your front foot out 90 degrees.
Bend your front knee to 90 degrees while keeping the back leg straight.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Gaze over your front hand and hold for 30 seconds.

name: Triangle Pose
description: A standing yoga pose that stretches the hamstrings, groin, and spine while opening the chest.
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart, front foot turned out.
Extend your arms at shoulder height and reach forward with the front hand.
Hinge at the hip and lower the front hand toward the floor or shin.
Extend the opposite arm toward the ceiling and hold for 30 seconds.

name: Seated Spinal Twist
description: A seated yoga pose that improves thoracic rotation and stretches the back.
instructions: Sit with legs extended, then cross one foot over the opposite thigh.
Place the opposite elbow outside the crossed knee.
Rotate your torso toward the crossed leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.

name: Happy Baby Pose
description: A supine yoga pose that opens the hips and stretches the inner groin.
instructions: Lie on your back and bring your knees toward your armpits.
Grab the outsides of your feet with your hands.
Gently pull your knees toward the floor beside your torso.
Rock gently side to side if desired.

name: Lizard Pose
description: A deep hip flexor and groin stretch performed in a low lunge position.
instructions: From a low lunge, place both hands inside the front foot.
Lower to your forearms if possible for a deeper stretch.
Let your hips sink toward the floor.
Hold for 30-60 seconds and switch sides.

name: Thoracic Spine Rotation
description: A mobility drill that improves rotation in the mid-back, which is often stiff from sitting.
instructions: Get on all fours and place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your upper body to bring that elbow toward the ceiling.
Return to the starting position.
Complete all reps and switch sides.

name: Shoulder Pass-Through
description: A shoulder mobility exercise using a broomstick or band to improve overhead range of motion.
instructions: Hold a stick or band with a wide overhand grip in front of you.
Slowly raise it overhead and behind your back in a large arc.
Return to the front in the same manner.
Gradually narrow your grip as mobility improves.

name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
description: A seated hip mobility drill that works both internal and external rotation.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg in front bent at 90 degrees and the other behind also at 90 degrees.
Keep your torso tall and lean gently over the front shin.
Feel the stretch in both hips.
Hold for 30 seconds and switch sides.

name: Frog Stretch
description: A deep groin and hip opener performed on all fours with wide knees.
instructions: Start on all fours and spread your knees as wide as comfortable.
Keep your feet in line with your knees, toes pointing outward.
Slowly push your hips back toward your heels.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.

name: Scorpion Stretch
description: A prone twist that opens the chest and hip flexors while improving spinal mobility.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended out to the sides.
Lift one leg and rotate it across your body toward the opposite hand.
Keep both arms on the ground and feel the stretch through your chest and hip.
Return to start and switch sides.

name: Standing Side Bend
description: A lateral stretch that lengthens the obliques and intercostal muscles.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and raise one arm overhead.
Lean to the opposite side, reaching your arm over your head.
Feel the stretch along the side of your torso.
Hold for 15-20 seconds and switch sides.

name: Single-Leg Stand
description: A basic balance exercise where you stand on one foot to improve stability.
instructions: Stand on one foot with a slight bend in the knee.
Keep your core engaged and gaze fixed on a point ahead.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.
Switch to the other foot.

name: Tree Pose
description: A yoga balance pose where you stand on one leg with the other foot on your inner thigh.
instructions: Stand on one leg and place the sole of the other foot on your inner thigh or calf.
Bring your hands to prayer position at your chest or raise them overhead.
Fix your gaze on a stationary point for balance.
Hold for 30 seconds and switch sides.

name: Single-Leg Deadlift
description: A balance and hip hinge exercise that targets the hamstrings and glutes on one leg.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hinge at the hips and extend the free leg behind you as a counterbalance.
Lower your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor.
Return to standing by driving the hips forward.

name: Plank to Push-Up
description: A transition exercise that alternates between forearm plank and high plank for arm and core endurance.
instructions: Start in a forearm plank position.
Press up to a high plank one arm at a time.
Lower back down to the forearm plank one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm each rep.

name: Reverse Plank
description: A posterior chain plank where you face upward, targeting the glutes and lower back.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended and hands behind you, fingers pointing toward your feet.
Lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your core tight.
Hold for the prescribed time.

name: Prone Y-Raise
description: A bodyweight exercise that strengthens the lower traps and improves shoulder health.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead forming a Y shape.
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades down and back.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Bench Close-Grip Push-Up
description: An incline push-up with a narrow hand placement on a bench for triceps emphasis.
instructions: Place your hands close together on the edge of a bench.
Walk your feet back until your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the bench, keeping elbows close to your body.
Press back up to the starting position.

name: Bench Single-Leg Squat
description: A single-leg squat to a bench that builds leg strength and balance progressively.
instructions: Stand on one leg in front of a bench.
Slowly lower yourself until you are seated on the bench.
Without using momentum, stand back up on the same leg.
Complete all reps before switching legs.

name: Bench Incline Dumbbell Row
description: A chest-supported row on an incline bench that isolates the back by removing momentum.
instructions: Set a bench to a 30-45 degree incline and lie face down on it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging straight down.
Row both dumbbells up toward your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Barbell Thruster
description: A full-body power exercise combining a front squat and overhead press in one explosive movement.
instructions: Hold a barbell in the front rack position at shoulder height.
Perform a front squat, lowering until thighs are parallel.
Drive up explosively and press the barbell overhead.
Lower the bar back to the front rack position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
description: A side lunge with dumbbells that targets the inner thighs and glutes with added resistance.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step wide to one side and bend that knee while keeping the other leg straight.
Push your hips back and keep the dumbbells near the bent leg.
Push off the bent leg to return to standing and alternate sides.

name: Warrior III Pose
description: An advanced single-leg balance pose that strengthens the standing leg and core.
instructions: Stand on one leg and hinge forward at the hips.
Extend your free leg behind you and your arms forward, forming a T shape.
Keep your hips level and core engaged.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.

name: Single-Leg Balance Reach
description: A balance exercise where you stand on one leg and reach in multiple directions.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Reach the free foot forward, to the side, and behind you while maintaining balance.
Return to center after each reach.
Complete all directions before switching legs.
